The bodies stay byte-identical to the sources; the frontmatter gains the six metadata keys scripts/ci/check_agent_frontmatter.py requires (capability, side_effect_level, approval_required, requires_tools, output_schema, risk_class). Retiring the synthet-agent-mailbox repo copies is a separate later PR.

comments.body: Superseded by scf-s41ph: the owner changed scope (TS agent-mail deprecated, Rust primary), so the skills are rewritten for the Rust stack and AC-1 (body byte-identical to the TS-era sources) no longer applies. No work was committed under this ticket.

title: Library: agent-mailbox and mail-dispatch as global skills
